value.message: We’ll need a few details from your Microsoft Azure Portal to finish this integration. To find this info, please refer to Microsoft’s guidance. This feature is a paid service. Contact your Microsoft representative or refer to Sidebar and Microsoft Teams overview to learn more.
The ID that’s associated with the app created in the portal. For example: 4c63d71f-5def-48a1-913c-e298ced2c00c
The ID that’s associated with the Teams org that will be linked to Sidebar discussions. For example: 4c63d71f-5def-48a1-913c-e298ced2c00c
The ID that's used to subscribe to Sidebar chats from Teams. For example: c100b123-abcd-45e6-7891-23e4567f89g1
The auto-assigned credentials used to authenticate the Azure app with Microsoft. For example: CmW8Q~HqTADTJVkUBXMdWG7yiFFikHJjd6rwEc6z rgy8Q~GoVqIRU99TVDxPEpxYXbV2y_K43nj-dcB-
The web location you’re sent to once you successfully log in to Microsoft Teams.
The web location Microsoft Teams uses to send a response to Sidebar.
You can only have one integration active at a time. If you proceed, the Slack integration will be deactivated, but its settings will be kept for later reactivation if needed.
